stories.headline: GTA 6 unlocks tomorrow.
stories.body: Rockstar says it unlocks at <mark>midnight local time on November 19</mark>, starting in New Zealand and rolling west. It's on <mark>PS5 and Xbox Series X|S</mark>. <mark>Preloads are open</mark> and the PS5 download is <mark>212GB</mark>, so clear space tonight.

stories.headline: Nvidia posted $115.8B without its CEO.
stories.body: Nvidia reported <mark>$115.84 billion</mark> in revenue, beating the <mark>$109.1 billion</mark> expected, and guided to <mark>$130 billion</mark> next quarter. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO last week and the board says it <mark>won't bring him back</mark>. Shares rose <mark>5%+ after hours</mark>.

stories.headline: Voyager 1 is now one light-day away.
stories.body: Launched in <mark>1977</mark>, Voyager 1 reaches <mark>one light-day</mark> from Earth today, about <mark>16 billion miles</mark>. A message now takes <mark>24 hours</mark> to get there, and the reply another day. <mark>Voyager 2</mark> won't get there until <mark>2035</mark>.

stories.headline: Instagram will hunt your reposts.
stories.body: Instagram is adding <mark>content protection</mark>: it scans for <mark>unauthorized copies</mark> of a creator's Reels and alerts them. They can <mark>block it</mark>, add an <mark>"original by" label</mark>, or leave it up. It will also flag <mark>AI videos reusing your audio</mark>. The AI part starts with a <mark>small group</mark> of creators.
